summary: E.W. Scripps filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a station swap with Gray Media. Scripps acquired KKTV (CBS) in Colorado Springs, KKCO (NBC) and KJCT-LP (ABC) in Grand Junction, and KMVT (CBS) and KSVT-LD (Fox) in Twin Falls, while Gray acquired WSYM (Fox) in Lansing and KATC (ABC) in Lafayette. The swap was an even exchange of comparable assets with no cash consideration, originally announced in July 2025. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a non-monetary asset swap, effectively a divestiture and acquisition simultaneously. Watch for regulatory clearance timelines and integration risks in the new markets.
